sources.title: Import AI 431: Technological Optimism and Appropriate Fear
sources.quote_checked: I do not see technical blockers in front of us. | We are growing extremely powerful systems that we do not fully understand. | You see, I am also deeply afraid. | what we are dealing with is a real and mysterious creature, not a simple and predictable machine. | But success isn't certain. | Are you anxious about misaligned AI systems? Force us to publish details on this.

sources.title: Jack Clark on AI's Uneven Impact (Ep. 242)
sources.quote_checked: I think my bear case on all of this is 3 percent, and my bull case is something like 5 percent. | I think we overestimate the ease with which we get into a physical world. | I am a technological pessimist who became an optimist through repeated beatings over the head of scale. | I worry that we are going to be bystanders to what in the future will seem like a great crime.
